procedure: Manual inspection of exact first/middle/last extracted frames and contact sheet, cross-checked with media-qa; no audio listening or model-based semantic oracle was used.

oracle.question: Does the collected artifact exist with the sealed MP4 hash and a decodable video/audio container?

limitations: Container validity is not semantic quality

oracle.question: Does the generated shot preserve the declared subject set and the hospital environment from Picture 1 and Picture 2?

limitations: The dog is broadly present, but the veterinarian, cat and bright veterinary-hospital environment declared by the references are absent; sparse manual samples do not establish all-frame identity

oracle.question: Does the shot remain decodable and exhibit a coherent bounded motion without freeze or corruption?

limitations: Only sparse frames were reviewed; no full-duration temporal semantic review was performed

oracle.question: Are the audio events intelligible, causally aligned and appropriate to the declared soundscape?

checks.reason: A native stream was present, but no listening or waveform-event review was run.
limitations: Audio stream presence is not audio semantic acceptance

oracle.question: Does the generated artifact satisfy the declared reference-conditioned identity/environment continuity target?

limitations: This is a single-shot probe, so adjacent-shot transition continuity was not applicable; the declared within-shot reference retention target failed

oracle.question: Is the shot acceptable for the intended production/editorial deliverable?

checks.reason: No editorial review or approved deliverable decision was performed.
limitations: Capability probe is not production acceptance
Probe evidence is local and exact, but it is not a production acceptance artifact
No dialogue/lip-sync or human editorial sign-off was performed
next_action: Keep reference conditioning at PARTIAL/UNPROVEN; adjust the reference workflow or model/profile and run a new bounded probe before any dependent chain.
